title: Finite-torsion constructibility
statement:
For the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], fix a prime
$\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ of its
valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$, and a
scheme $Y$. On the small pro-etale site
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, put

$$
  A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n.
$$

A sheaf of $A_{E,n}$-modules on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is *constructible* if
there is a finite disjoint partition $Y=\bigsqcup_{\nu=1}^N Y_\nu$ by locally
closed constructible subschemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and
the restriction to each $Y_\nu$ is locally constant with finite
$A_{E,n}$-module stalks. For a derived complex, for every $i\in\mathbf Z$,
write $\mathcal H^i$ for its cohomology sheaves
[def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Define

$$
 D^b_c(Y,A_{E,n})\subset D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})
$$

to be the full triangulated subcategory of complexes with finitely many
nonzero cohomology sheaves, all constructible.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the blueprint source (master; no slopmaster2 copy found by id), against Stacks Definition 61.27.1 (Tag 09AJ) and Bhatt-Scholze Definition 1.1. Statement kept. Named the notions it is built from: the global finite-field datum (prime p, so that l != p makes sense) [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]; E, O_E, the uniformizer and A_{E,n} [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, added]; the small pro-etale site, its module sheaves and D(Y_proet, A) [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]; locally closed constructible subsets [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]; the constructibility clause of the second paragraph, now stated for any finite coefficient ring as the new node def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf (unsplit; built from the stratification, the module inverse image along the strata, locally constant sheaves and stalks); the cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]; full triangulated subcategory, new Mathlib leaf def-weil-triangulated-subcategory (ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated); and the fact that the subcategory so defined is triangulated, which the definition presupposes, as the new unsplit statement lem-weil-proetale-dbc-triangulated (Stacks 09AL proof, from the weak Serre property 09B5). Being bounded (finitely many nonzero H^i) is elementary from the cohomology sheaves. Mathlib has the pro-etale site Scheme.ProEt, IsConstructible, IsLocallyClosed, Sheaf.IsConstant, DerivedCategory and ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated, but no locally constant or constructible sheaves on a site.
